# Reused office code

| Repository | Reused file | Runtime use | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| My Virtual Office | app/office-life/sprites.js | Cached folder and envelope pixel props | AGPL-3.0 |
| OpenClaw Pixel Agents | src/game/Pathfinder.ts, furnitureGeometry.ts | Wall and furniture obstacle map | MIT |
| Claw3D | src/lib/office/pathfinding.ts | A* routes between agents and meeting point | MIT |
| Agent Office | src/scene/officeLayout.ts | Visual lead-role marker | MIT |
| Pixel Claw | client/public/sprites/characters/char_0.png through char_5.png | Animated office characters | MIT repository license |

Original files, pinned commits and notices are in third-party/projects.json and third-party/samples. The six character images are copied unchanged. TypeScript modules are emitted with Node stripTypeScriptTypes. The My Virtual Office sprite module is copied unchanged. The supplied web application includes AGPL-3.0 code. Its source and the upstream license are included in this distribution.
